# bookmatch — a Goodreads taste-profile and recommendation service

## What it is

bookmatch is a Python service that turns a Goodreads account into a taste profile and grounded book recommendations. It runs as a systemd unit, `bookmatch.service`, on the host aurora, executing the checkout in place from `/home/gui/src/products/bookmatch`. The service listens on port `:8092` and exposes an HTTP API.

The pipeline has two stages. First, `scripts/build_index.py` builds a user-item rating matrix from the UCSD Goodreads corpus (Wan & McAuley 2018), keeping only explicit ratings (rating > 0). It reads input from the `BOOKMATCH_RAW` environment variable, defaulting to `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/raw`, and writes output to `BOOKMATCH_INDEX`, defaulting to `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/index`. The script is idempotent and rewrites the index directory on each run.

Second, the app package (`bookmatch/`) serves the analysis and recommendation flows. The app calls `storage.ensure_schema_ready()` at startup, which verifies the `books.*` schema exists and raises if missing — the schema is never created as a side effect of app start. The correctness surface `books.v_bookmatch_correctness` is defined in `sql/v_bookmatch_correctness.sql`.

Deployment is in-place via `deploy.sh`. The script refuses to deploy if the working tree is dirty, restarts the unit with `sudo -n systemctl restart`, and polls `/api/health` for `ok` and `corpus_ready` status. On success it records the deployed revision in `.deploy-last-good`; on health-check failure it rolls back to the last known-good revision and still exits non-zero.

## Why it exists

The service recreates the June-2026 Goodreads "impossible insights" recommendation engine as a MyApps app. It exists to give an owner a grounded, veto-able recommendation flow: add a Goodreads account, run analysis, get a taste profile plus recommendations, veto unwanted ones, and chat with an agent about what that person would like.

## How it is used

- **Owner** deploys via `deploy.sh`, which restarts the unit and proves health through `/api/health`.
- **Agent** interacts through the HTTP API on port `:8092`, including the health endpoint.
- **Automatic consumers** read the correctness surface `books.v_bookmatch_correctness`, which asserts the pipeline produced a grounded result per account.
- **CI** runs the pytest suite on push/PR via `.github/workflows/tests.yml`; the pre-push hook runs the same suite locally.

## Boundaries

- **Owns:** the taste-profile and recommendation pipeline from Goodreads account to grounded recommendations; the index build from the UCSD corpus; the `books.*` schema; the correctness view `books.v_bookmatch_correctness`; the in-place deploy and rollback procedure.
- **Never does:** download the dataset at app start — the dataset is fetched once by `scripts/download_dataset.sh` into `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/raw` (gitignored), and the index is built separately; create the schema as a side effect of app start or test run — `storage.ensure_schema_ready()` verifies only and raises if `books.*` is missing.
- **Escalates to owner:** a failed health check after deploy — the script rolls back to last-good but still exits non-zero, marking the deploy as failed; a dirty working tree — the deploy refuses to proceed.
- **Owner:** UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
